تواقفت (form VI)
# تَوَاقَفْتُ (tawāqaftu) /ta.waː.qaf.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَوَاقَفَ (tawāqafa)
# تَوَاقَفْتَ (tawāqafta) /ta.waː.qaf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَوَاقَفَ (tawāqafa)
# تَوَاقَفْتِ (tawāqafti) /ta.waː.qaf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَوَاقَفَ (tawāqafa)
# تَوَاقَفَتْ (tawāqafat) /ta.waː.qa.fat/: third-person fem
